# kwb.rabimo

R-implementation of a simple water balance model for urban areas,

- based on “Wasserhaushaltsmodell Berlin ABIMO 3.2” (see Documentation
  below) and
- further developed by [KWB](https://kompetenz-wasser.de) within
  [BMBF](https://www.bmbf.de/EN/Home/home_node.html)-funded research
  project [AMAREX](https://amarex-projekt.de/en).

For our Tutorial, click
[here](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/articles/tutorial.html) (see
also Documentation below).

## Installation

``` r

# Install package "remotes" from CRAN
install.packages("remotes", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")

# Install package "kwb.rabimo" (latest "release") from GitHub
remotes::install_github("KWB-R/kwb.rabimo", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## Basic Usage

### Provide input data and configuration

For Berlin, the capital of Germany, we provide input data and model
parameters in the package:

``` r

# Load Berlin data in the original Abimo format
abimo_inputs <- kwb.rabimo::rabimo_inputs_2025
```

### Run R-Abimo for the status quo

``` r

# Run R-Abimo, the R-implementation of Abimo
rabimo_result <- kwb.rabimo::run_rabimo(
  data = abimo_inputs$data, 
  config = abimo_inputs$config
)

# Have a look at the first lines of the result data frame
head(rabimo_result)
```

### Run R-Abimo for a natural state scenario

``` r

rabimo_result_natural <- kwb.rabimo::run_rabimo(
  data = kwb.rabimo::data_to_natural(abimo_inputs$data), 
  config = new_inputs$config
)
```

### Calculate “Delta-W”

For the first ten blocks, calculate the deviation from the natural
state:

``` r

kwb.rabimo::calculate_delta_w(
  urban = rabimo_result[1:10, ],
  natural = rabimo_result_natural
)
```

## Documentation

### R-package kwb.rabimo

- Package Home: <https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo>
- Tutorial: <https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/articles/tutorial.html>

### Original software “Wasserhaushaltsmodell Berlin ABIMO 3.2”

- Source code (C++): <https://github.com/umweltatlas/abimo>,
- User manual (in German):
  <https://www.berlin.de/umweltatlas/_assets/literatur/goedecke_et_al_abimo2019_doku.pdf>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`calculate_delta_w()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/calculate_delta_W.md)
  : Deviation from Natural Water Balance (Delta-W)
- [`crop_box()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/crop_box.md)
  : Crop a box out of a shape
- [`data_to_natural()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/data_to_natural.md)
  : Transform R-Abimo input Data into their natural scenario equivalent
- [`define_controls()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/define_controls.md)
  : Define List of "Controls"
- [`generate_rabimo_area()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/generate_rabimo_area.md)
  : Generate an area in R-Abimo format with default values
- [`get_measure_stats()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/get_measure_stats.md)
  : Get Mean/Max Statistics on Measures
- [`get_soil_properties()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/get_soil_properties.md)
  : Calculate Soil Properties
- [`rabimo_inputs_2020`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/rabimo_inputs_2020.md)
  : R-Abimo Inputs (Data and Config) for Berlin, 2020
- [`rabimo_inputs_2025`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/rabimo_inputs_2025.md)
  : R-Abimo Inputs (Data and Config) for Berlin, 2025.
- [`read_column_info()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/read_column_info.md)
  : Provide Meta Information About Input Columns
- [`real_evapo_transpiration()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/real_evapo_transpiration.md)
  : Calculate Actual Evapotranspiration with Bagrov
- [`run_rabimo()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/run_rabimo.md)
  : Run R-Abimo, the R-implementation of Water Balance Model Abimo
- [`run_rabimo_with_measures()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/run_rabimo_with_measures.md)
  : Distribute Rainwater Management Measures and run R-Abimo
- [`test_plumber_api()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/test_plumber_api.md)
  : Test the API to main functions using the plumber package and swagger
- [`triangle_of_fractions()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.rabimo/reference/triangle_of_fractions.md)
  : Plot Triangle of Three Fractions
